mainEntity.name: What is the difference between traditional SEO and AI Overviews optimization for local businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional local SEO focuses on ranking in the organic search results and local pack by optimizing for keywords, backlinks, and technical aspects. AI Overviews optimization, while overlapping with traditional SEO, places a stronger emphasis on content that directly answers questions and provides immediate value, which is crucial for AI models to synthesize information. It involves structuring data explicitly for AI comprehension and ensuring factual accuracy across all online presences. The goal shifts slightly from just ranking to being the definitive, synthesizable answer for AI-generated summaries.
